ontology.name: Aramco HSE Site Intelligence
ontology.description: Ontology for the Aramco HSE site management database. Describes all entities, their attributes, relationships, business concepts and common query patterns. This ontology is passed to the LLM before every SQL generation request.
ontology.site_context: Industrial oil and gas facility undergoing a turnaround (planned maintenance shutdown). Site has ~2,400 workers, ~450 active permits, multiple hazard zones with hot-work, confined-space and other high-risk activities.

zone.description: A physical area or unit within the facility. Zones have hazard classifications and contain workers, permits and assets.
zone.real_world_meaning: Physical locations like Unit 2 Hydrocracker, Unit 3 Coker, Tank Farm North, Admin area

id.description: Unique zone identifier e.g. Z1, Z2, Z3

hazard_level.note: High hazard zones require valid permits for all work

geo_polygon.description: GeoJSON polygon of zone boundary for map rendering

permit.description: A work permit authorizing specific activities in a specific zone for a specific time window. Permits expire at valid_to. After expiry, workers must stop and vacate the zone.
permit.real_world_meaning: Official safety authorization document. Without a valid permit, work in a hazard zone is illegal and dangerous.

permit_type.note: hot-work = welding/cutting/grinding near flammable materials. confined-space = entry into enclosed spaces with limited access

status.note: expired = past valid_to time. breached = conditions violated. Workers must stop work when permit expires or is breached.

valid_to.description: When permit expires. After this time status should be expired.

issuer.description: Person or role who issued the permit

flagged_job_id.description: If this permit is linked to a flagged job violation, this references it

extension_requested.description: Whether an extension was formally requested

flagged_job.description: A job or work activity that has been flagged as a violation — typically because workers are still on location inside a hazard zone with an expired, breached or missing permit. Flagged jobs are the core safety alerts on the site.
flagged_job.real_world_meaning: A detected safety violation where work is happening without proper authorization. Each flagged job is ranked by severity.

permit_id.description: The permit that is expired or breached

workers_on_site.description: Number of workers still physically present in the hazard zone for this job. This is the count of people who need to be contacted to stop work.

reason.description: Narrative explanation of why this was flagged

detected_at.description: When the violation was first detected

evidence.description: Structured evidence block including permit record, location trail, timestamps

worker.description: A person on site — either Aramco staff or contractor. Workers have a current zone based on their last location signal. Workers are linked to zones not directly to permits.
worker.real_world_meaning: Every tagged person on site with a location tracking device.

zone_id.description: Current zone from last location fix

last_coordinates.description: GeoJSON point {lat, lng} of last known position

worker.note: To find workers on expired permits, join via zone: worker.zone_id = permit.zone_id WHERE permit.status = 'expired'. OR use flagged_job.workers_on_site which is the pre-computed count.

permit_condition.description: Individual safety conditions that must be met for a permit to remain valid. Each permit has multiple conditions.

detail.description: Narrative detail about the condition state

sources.description: Data sources that determined this condition state

gas_test_reading.description: Gas test readings for confined-space permits. Tests must be repeated at regular intervals.

interval_minutes.description: Required interval between tests, typically 15 minutes

permit_entrant.description: People who have entered a confined space under a specific permit.

entered_at.description: When they entered the confined space

permit_entry_exit_log.description: Chronological log of all entry and exit events for a permit.

muster_event.description: A muster drill or emergency muster event. Tracks real-time progress of accounting for all personnel on site.
muster_event.real_world_meaning: Emergency roll call — everyone on site must report to their designated muster point.

measured_completion_label.description: Formatted elapsed time when last drill completed e.g. 2:47

muster_point.description: A designated assembly point where workers gather during a muster. Each point covers specific zones.

covers_zones.description: Array of zone names this muster point serves

capacity.description: Maximum people this point can accommodate

accounted_count.description: Personnel confirmed at this point so far

geo_point.description: GeoJSON point location of muster point

signal.description: An automatically detected anomaly or condition requiring attention. Signals are generated by the signal detection engine by monitoring raw data tables. They are pre-computed safety alerts.
signal.real_world_meaning: AI-detected site anomalies — expired permits with live occupancy, gas tests overdue, asset alarms with permits nearby etc.

action.description: A prioritized action item for the persona to complete. Actions are ranked by risk priority.

target_system.description: System where action will be logged

asset.description: Equipment or machinery on site with health monitoring. Assets can have alarms that affect nearby permit safety.

asset_reading.description: Sensor readings for an asset — vibration, temperature, pressure etc.

series.description: Array of recent historical values for trend display

source_system.description: Which monitoring system produced this reading

reconciliation_run.description: A headcount reconciliation event — comparing worker counts across multiple source systems to get one trusted figure.

reconciliation_source.description: Individual source system contribution to a reconciliation run.

source_name.example: Gate access-control, Permit-to-work system, Contractor timesheets

delta.description: Difference from reconciled figure. Non-zero means this source disagrees.

reliability.description: Qualitative reliability rating of this source

data_source.description: Connected external data systems that feed the TrackLynk platform.

relationships.permit_to_zone: permit.zone_id → zone.id — A permit authorizes work in one zone
relationships.flagged_job_to_permit: flagged_job.permit_id → permit.id — A flagged job references the permit that is expired or breached
relationships.flagged_job_to_zone: flagged_job.zone_id → zone.id — The zone where the violation is occurring
relationships.worker_to_zone: worker.zone_id → zone.id — Worker's current location zone
relationships.asset_to_zone: asset.zone_id → zone.id — Zone where asset is located
relationships.permit_condition_to_permit: permit_condition.permit_id → permit.id — Conditions belonging to a permit
relationships.gas_test_to_permit: gas_test_reading.permit_id → permit.id — Gas test readings for a confined-space permit
relationships.entrant_to_permit: permit_entrant.permit_id → permit.id — People who entered under a permit
relationships.log_to_permit: permit_entry_exit_log.permit_id → permit.id — Entry/exit events for a permit

expired_permit_with_live_occupancy.description: The most critical HSE violation — workers still on location after permit expiry
expired_permit_with_live_occupancy.query_pattern: SELECT fj.*, p.valid_to, p.permit_type, z.name as zone_name FROM flagged_job fj JOIN permit p ON p.id = fj.permit_id JOIN zone z ON z.id = fj.zone_id WHERE p.status = 'expired' AND fj.workers_on_site > 0 ORDER BY fj.rank
expired_permit_with_live_occupancy.key_fields: flagged_job.workers_on_site = people still on location, permit.valid_to = when it expired

people_on_expired_permits.description: How many workers are still inside hazard zones with expired permits
people_on_expired_permits.query_pattern: SELECT SUM(fj.workers_on_site) as total_workers, COUNT(fj.id) as flagged_jobs FROM flagged_job fj JOIN permit p ON p.id = fj.permit_id WHERE p.status = 'expired'

locations_of_expired_permits.description: Where expired permit violations are happening
locations_of_expired_permits.query_pattern: SELECT p.id, p.permit_type, z.name as zone_name, fj.location_description, fj.workers_on_site FROM permit p JOIN zone z ON z.id = p.zone_id JOIN flagged_job fj ON fj.permit_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'expired' AND p.permit_type = 'hot-work'

high_risk_permits.description: Permits in the safety or health risk buckets
high_risk_permits.query_pattern: SELECT * FROM permit WHERE status = 'valid' AND risk_bucket IN ('safety', 'health')

muster_unaccounted.description: Personnel not yet confirmed at muster points
muster_unaccounted.query_pattern: SELECT mp.name, mp.expected_count - mp.accounted_count as unaccounted FROM muster_point mp WHERE mp.accounted_count < mp.expected_count

asset_alarm_near_permits.description: Assets in alarm state with active permits in the same zone
asset_alarm_near_permits.query_pattern: SELECT a.tag, a.name, a.alarm_state, COUNT(p.id) as permits_in_zone FROM asset a JOIN permit p ON p.zone_id = a.zone_id WHERE a.alarm_state = 'alarm' AND p.status = 'valid' GROUP BY a.id, a.tag, a.name, a.alarm_state

headcount_discrepancy.description: Why headcounts from different systems disagree
headcount_discrepancy.query_pattern: SELECT rs.source_name, rs.record_count, rs.delta, rs.reliability FROM reconciliation_source rs JOIN reconciliation_run rr ON rr.id = rs.reconciliation_id ORDER BY rr.as_of DESC
